title: Which Box Hides the Diamond?
youtube_description:
Can YOU find the hidden diamond? Pick your box and see if you're right! 💎🟥🟦🟩 Watch to the end for the big reveal!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Kidify #DiamondChallenge #FunForKids #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: One of these boxes is hiding a giant diamond!
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the green box? Pick one fast!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue green gift boxes row

scenes.narration: We open the red box and it's… a rubber chicken! Not even close!
The blue box has… a smelly old sock! Ewww, try again!
That means the green box has the diamond! Open it up… YES! There it is — sparkling and beautiful!
Did you pick green? You're a genius! Level two tomorrow — don't miss it!
